## Proposed change
<!--

  maintainers why we should accept this pull request. If it fixes a bug
  or resolves a feature request, be sure to link to that issue in the

This PR adds an options flow to the SimpliSafe integration.

This also fixes a bug wherein the SimpliSafe integration would ignore a `code` provided during setup. I elected to merge these two changes together into one PR so as to avoid having a breaking change (wherein users would need to delete and re-add their SimpliSafe integration).

<!--

  your PR. Furthermore, for new integrations, it gives an impression of how
  the configuration would look like.

-->

```yaml

simplisafe:
  accounts:
    - username: !secret simplisafe_email

      code: 1234
```

## The problem
<!-- 
  Describe the issue you are experiencing here to communicate to the
  maintainers. Tell us what you were trying to do and what happened instead.
-->
The Lovelace alarm panel does not display a keypad for simplisafe alarm
I believe the issues is due to this breaking change https://github.com/home-assistant/core/issues/19922#issuecomment-453195528
The simplisafe integration does not set property code_format, its null.
It needs to be set to Number.

## Environment
<!--
  Provide details about the versions you are using, which helps us to reproduce
  and find the issue quicker. Version information is found in the
  Home Assistant frontend: Developer tools -> Info.
-->

- Home Assistant release with the issue: 0.104.3
- Last working Home Assistant release (if known): N/A
- Operating environment (Hass.io/Docker/Windows/etc.): Hass.io
- Integration causing this issue: simplisafe
- Link to integration documentation on our website: https://www.home-assistant.io/integrations/simplisafe/

## Problem-relevant `configuration.yaml`
<!--
  An example configuration that caused the problem for you. Fill this out even
  if it seems unimportant to you. Please be sure to remove personal information
  like passwords, private URLs and other credentials.
-->

```yaml

```

<!--
  If you come across any trace or error logs, please provide them.
-->

```txt

```

## Additional information
comments:
Please update the latest version since this seems to be implemented, see especially line 130-131:
https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/558da56d7543ed990dea1a627792b6846ebd6ad4/homeassistant/components/simplisafe/alarm_control_panel.py#L125-L132

I upgraded to 0.106.4 and I still don't have code_format set.
I have set the code in the configuration and it is a number. I have tried it quoted and not quoted.

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/19938737/75845794-14ddad00-5d8f-11ea-8289-01aee4f6a6aa.png)

Is it missing the entry into the _attrs dictionary. Nothing is calling code_format.

https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/558da56d7543ed990dea1a627792b6846ebd6ad4/homeassistant/components/simplisafe/alarm_control_panel.py#L190-L213
Please add your configuration.yaml snippet of this integration so we can take a look :)

Sure but there isn't much to it that's not a secret.

```
simplisafe:
  accounts:
    - username: username
      password: password
      code: 0000
```

I've also tried quoting the code like this "0000"

The configuration works and this Lovelace card (the default built-in one) can arm / disarm the alarm. But it should require a code and display a keypad

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/19938737/75910210-53f91600-5e02-11ea-8b75-d2fb19a9f017.png)

Thanks for assisting.

Hey there @bachya, mind taking a look at this issue as its been labeled with a integration (`simplisafe`) you are listed as a [codeowner](https://github.com/home-assistant/core/blob/dev/CODEOWNERS#L311) for? Thanks!

@jpearce73 I just merged a fix for this. Since we’re already in the beta window for 0.107.0, this will likely go out in 0.108.0. Note that when it does, you’ll need to go into `Configuration >> Integrations >> Your SimpliSafe Entry`, click on the gear entry at the top of the screen, and input your desired code there.

Hey, thank you very much.

I'll look out for 108.
At the moment I configure things with conguration.yaml (as above), are you saying that adding code to the yaml will no longer work? 
If that still works, I'll also test the GUI to see what that experience is like.
@jpearce73 You can still use `configuration.yaml`; in that case, you'll have to delete you existing SimpliSafe integration via the UI, then restart HASS.
